column1: # ASDF build-target registry — single source of truth.
# Consumed by make-targets.sh (target lists by category)
# tests run against). Each target also needs a workflow preset of the same
# name in CMakePresets.json; the host test presets_match_targets checks this.
#   category : avr | test | arm_m0+ | sim   (determines how the target is built)
#   simavr   : yes => exercised by the simavr integration tests (AVR only)
